subject: Phase 100220 JSON Export and Import Implementation (Round 1)
verdict_justification: While the implementation delivers all required MCP schemas and achieves >=90% test coverage, workspace make lint fails with a clippy doc-markdown error, live import executes un-batched store mutations during planning that break transaction rollback guarantees, ciphertext backup import double-encrypts ciphertext and drops item metadata, and tombstone records are omitted from array canonicalization.
standard: FR-29: JSON export with completeness manifest, dsar_plaintext and ciphertext_backup modes, idempotent import enforcing §4.1-§4.2
NFR-6: All confidence, admission-score, and telemetry fields included in data export
Phase 100220 Specification & Appendix: Canonical JSON checksum verification before writes, atomic transactional batches on import
AGENTS.md and Makefile Quality Gates: make lint, make test, make coverage with >=90% line and function coverage per file

requirements.evidence: Single-file bundle with completeness manifest implemented in crates/clio-compliance/src/export.rs; however, tasks and failures are silently truncated at 10,000 without setting complete=false.
Idempotent skip logic works on clean re-import; however, live import mutations are performed during Planner::run before batch commit, breaking atomicity and transactional rollback.
import(dry_run=true) reports counts without mutating store; verified by dry_run_reports_and_leaves_store_unchanged test.
Export masks snapshots via masked_clone and gists via scrub_inline_secrets; verified by t22_06_secrets_never_reach_the_file.
import_provider returns PROVIDER_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED, writes 0, and masks credentials; verified by t22_07 test.
Export lists assoc edges and includes in bundle; import plans PutAssocEdge batch effects.

requirements.requirement: AC-100220-07 DSAR plaintext vs ciphertext modes
requirements.evidence: Export produces opaque items without DEKs, but import calls put_item which double-encrypts ciphertext and drops all NFR-6 metadata.

requirements.requirement: Definition of Done: Tests pass, clippy clean, files <= 450 lines

findings.title: Live import executes un-batched store mutations during `Planner::run`, violating transactional rollback guarantees
findings.evidence: In crates/clio-compliance/src/import.rs:138-146, planner.run()? is invoked before args.batch.apply_batch(chunk). In crates/clio-compliance/src/import_apply.rs:151,271,272,286,370,390 and crates/clio-compliance/src/import_rows.rs:250,283, direct store mutations (store.update_memory_item, store.put_item, store.put_assoc_edge, persona.put_preference_state, belief.append_confidence, belief_observe) execute immediately when !args.dry_run. If any subsequent planning step or batch chunk fails, these mutations remain permanently committed to the store without rollback.
findings.recommendation: Defer all database mutations until after planning succeeds. Either extend BatchWrite and apply_batch to cover preferences, beliefs, and opaque envelopes, or wrap live execution in an explicit database transaction that aborts and rolls back on failure.

findings.title: `make lint` fails with clippy doc-markdown error on `crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs:238`
findings.evidence: Command `make lint` fails with exit code 101: `error: item in documentation is missing backticks` at `crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs:238:5` (`key/as_of` without backticks). Clippy `-D warnings` is enforced across all workspace targets and features.
findings.requirement_ref: Definition of Done, AGENTS.md §Final Verification, Makefile make lint
findings.recommendation: Wrap `key/as_of` in backticks in crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs:238 so make lint compiles cleanly.

findings.title: Ciphertext backup import invokes `Store::put_item`, double-encrypting ciphertext and discarding all item metadata
findings.evidence: In crates/clio-compliance/src/import_apply.rs:260-287, opaque_items are imported via args.store.put_item(&envelope). In crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_store.rs:38 and postgres_store.rs, put_item treats item.content as plaintext, generating a local DEK and re-encrypting the ciphertext. Furthermore, crates/clio-store/src/envelope_persist.rs:49-55 inserts hardcoded defaults (kind='episodic', category=NULL, episodic_type='temporal', valid_from=now), discarding all preserved OpaqueItem metadata (confidence, admission_score, category, epistemic_kind, valid_from/until). Subsequent get_memory_item calls on restored items fail.
findings.requirement_ref: FR-29, NFR-6, Appendix §3, Phase 100220 doc §5 Task 1 & Task 2
findings.recommendation: Preserve all OpaqueItem metadata fields and write pre-encrypted ciphertext directly to items.content_ciphertext via a dedicated put_opaque_item store method without re-encrypting through KMS.

findings.title: `sort_entity_arrays` omits `ComplianceTombstoneView`, breaking canonical ordering and cross-backend checksum equivalence
findings.evidence: crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs:276-288 sorts arrays using fields ['id', 'key', 'as_of']. ComplianceTombstoneView (crates/clio-store/src/compliance_store.rs:80) contains none of these fields, so sort_entity_arrays leaves tombstones in their original order. Furthermore, SQLite orders tombstones NULLs-First (crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_erase.rs:46) while Postgres orders NULLs-Last (crates/clio-store/src/postgres_erase_read.rs:40), causing checksum divergence across backends for identical tombstone datasets.
findings.recommendation: Add tombstone comparator fields (subject_hash, item_id_hash, request_id) to sort_entity_arrays in crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs, and harmonize SQL tombstone ordering between SQLite and Postgres (ORDER BY item_id_hash NULLS LAST).

findings.title: `export` silently truncates tasks and failures at `HISTORY_LIMIT = 10_000` while manifest reports `complete = true`
findings.evidence: crates/clio-compliance/src/export.rs:47,288,295 caps task and failure enumeration at HISTORY_LIMIT = 10_000. The manifest builder in export.rs:404-422 only checks ExportFilter flags and does not inspect whether task or failure listings reached HISTORY_LIMIT. If truncated, the manifest is emitted with complete: true and no omission note.
findings.recommendation: Inspect total task and failure counts or check if list_tasks/list_failures returned HISTORY_LIMIT rows; if so, append an omission note and set complete: false in the manifest.

findings.title: `validate_envelope` permits invalid `format_version == 0`
findings.evidence: crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs:313 only rejects if envelope.format_version > BUNDLE_FORMAT_VERSION. If an imported bundle supplies format_version: 0, the check passes even though version 0 is unsupported.
findings.requirement_ref: Phase 100220 doc §5 Task 1, Appendix §1, §10 Failure Handling
findings.recommendation: Reject format_version == 0 by asserting envelope.format_version == BUNDLE_FORMAT_VERSION or envelope.format_version >= 1 in validate_envelope.

issues.title: Live import executes un-batched store mutations during `Planner::run`, violating transactional rollback guarantees
issues.why_it_matters: If import fails partway through execution, partial writes remain committed to the database with no rollback mechanism, causing inconsistent state and corrupted banks.
issues.impact: Violates §5 Task 2 and §10 rollback requirements; corrupts state on mid-batch failure.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-compliance/src/import.rs:138 calls planner.run()?, which executes direct mutations in import_apply.rs:151,271,272,286,370,390 and import_rows.rs:250,283 before batch commit.
issues.proposed_fix: Defer all mutations until planning validates the entire bundle, and execute all writes within an atomic batch or transaction.

issues.title: `make lint` fails with clippy doc-markdown error on `crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs:238`
issues.why_it_matters: Breaks workspace CI and quality gates; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -D warnings exits 101.
issues.impact: Codebase fails automated lint verification despite developer sign-off.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs:238:5 doc comment contains key/as_of without backticks.
issues.proposed_fix: Wrap `key/as_of` in backticks on line 238 of crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs.

issues.title: Ciphertext backup import invokes `Store::put_item`, double-encrypting ciphertext and discarding all item metadata
issues.why_it_matters: Restoring a ciphertext backup produces unusable rows: ciphertext is re-encrypted with local KMS DEK, item columns are wiped, and get_memory_item fails.
issues.impact: ciphertext_backup round-trip claims are broken; restored data is unreadable.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-compliance/src/import_apply.rs:260-287 passes opaque ciphertext to Store::put_item, which encrypts it again and inserts dummy episodic rows in envelope_persist.rs:49-55.
issues.proposed_fix: Persist OpaqueItem rows directly to items table preserving metadata and writing pre-encrypted content_ciphertext without re-encryption.

issues.title: `sort_entity_arrays` omits `ComplianceTombstoneView`, breaking canonical ordering and cross-backend checksum equivalence
issues.why_it_matters: Tombstone arrays are not canonically ordered, causing checksum mismatches on cross-backend import and non-deterministic bundle hashes.
issues.impact: Breaks Appendix §4 canonical JSON checksum verification when tombstones are present.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs:276-288 only inspects id, key, and as_of; ComplianceTombstoneView has none of these, leaving tombstones in raw database order (which differs between SQLite and Postgres).
issues.proposed_fix: Add tombstone comparator fields (subject_hash, item_id_hash, request_id) to sort_entity_arrays and align SQLite/Postgres tombstone SQL order.

issues.title: `export` silently truncates tasks and failures at `HISTORY_LIMIT = 10_000` while manifest reports `complete = true`
issues.why_it_matters: Completeness manifests must truthfully report complete=false when data is truncated. Silent truncation produces incomplete exports falsely certified as complete.
issues.impact: Violates FR-29 manifest integrity contract on large task/failure stores.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-compliance/src/export.rs:47 caps history queries at 10,000, but completeness() in export.rs:404-422 never checks if truncation occurred.
issues.proposed_fix: Detect if task/failure count equals HISTORY_LIMIT and mark complete=false with an explanatory omission note.

issues.title: `validate_envelope` permits invalid `format_version == 0`
issues.why_it_matters: Version gate should reject unsupported version numbers strictly.
issues.impact: format_version 0 is improperly accepted instead of rejected.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-compliance/src/bundle.rs:313 checks `envelope.format_version > BUNDLE_FORMAT_VERSION` which evaluates false for version 0.
issues.proposed_fix: Change version validation condition to `envelope.format_version == 0 || envelope.format_version > BUNDLE_FORMAT_VERSION`.
